response.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT sf.zoneref, s.entrystat, sf.traitcount FROM scanfeatures sf JOIN sites s ON sf.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sf.traitcount >= 489), grouped AS (SELECT zoneref AS site_code, entrystat AS access_status, AVG(traitcount) AS avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM filtered GROUP BY zoneref, entrystat) SELECT site_code, access_status, avg_traitcount, record_count, record_count * 1.0 / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM grouped ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: "Passes the 489 threshold" means traitcount >= 489 (meets or exceeds). The request does not settle whether 489 itself is included.
The share denominator is the total record count across all groups in the same filtered, site-matched population. Records with a NULL entrystat form their own group rather than being dropped.

alternatives.interpretation: "Passes the threshold" means traitcount strictly greater than 489, excluding records exactly equal to 489.
